text:
alex: Drafting internal release notes & announcement for v0.12.3 — deploy scheduled in the 11:00 PT change window tomorrow. Can people review the blurb and canary plan below?

sam: pinged. I'll update wording for the customer-facing bullets. :+1:

alex: quick draft:
```
Release v0.12.3 — improvements to routing and cache efficiency
- Reduced tail latency on short-chat workloads (~12% median)
- Model pinning: xgen-1.3 will be default for hosted API (opt-out available)
- Fix: KV cache leak under heavy batching

Rollout plan:
- Canary: 10% of traffic for 30m, metric gates (latency, errors, token cost)
- If canary fails -> automatic rollback to v0.12.2 and incident channel notify
```

luis: need to call out the model pinning instructions and migration steps. Add: how to opt out via request param or account settings.

product-marketing: Add a one-line internal announcement for #general and the weekly all-hands email. Suggest: "v0.12.3 deploy tomorrow 11am PT: routing & perf improvements; see internal notes for details."

zoe: please add customer impact summary. e.g., "expected to reduce latency for live-chat products; no action required."

sam: tiny wording tweak to the changelog bullets and add co-authors: @luis, @zoe.

ops-oncall: Rollback runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback. Ops will be oncall at deploy. Confirming rollback criterion: 5% increase in 95p latency OR >1% user-facing errors for 10m.

alex: updated draft with PM/ops notes. Next: product-marketing, can you provide the Slack + email copy?

product-marketing: Slack blurb ready: "Heads up — v0.12.3 deploying tomorrow 11:00 PT. Improvements to latency and routing; no customer action expected. Full notes: <internal link>" Email snippet: "Tomorrow we'll roll out v0.12.3 with improvements to inference routing that reduce latency for short-horizon chat. No downtime expected."

deploy-bot: Scheduled: v0.12.3 -> prod at 1748084400 (2025-06-22 18:00 UTC). Canary config: 10% traffic, 30m, gates: latency_p50/p95, error_rate.

alex: final question: do we want to pin model in hosted API immediately or stage it after canary?

luis: prefer: pin after canary success (avoid user confusion). We'll set default but not force migration until +24h. Add note in release about opt-in vs default.

zoe: agreed. Also mention monitoring dashboard link and slack alert channel.

ops-oncall: I'm adding the rollback command here for quick access: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/redwood-inference --to-revision=2025-06-21-12` — ops will execute if gates trip.

sam: looks good. +1 from me, minor grammar.

alex: great — I'll merge this into the internal docs and schedule the announcement. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary started (v0.12.3) — canary traffic 10% at 1748084600.

deploy-bot: Canary health check: 1m passed.

deploy-bot: Canary failed: increased p95 by 18% vs baseline at 1748084820. Initiating automatic rollback to v0.12.2. Notifying #incidents.

ops-oncall: executing rollback now. Will post status updates in #incidents.

alex: switching announcement to "deploy paused / rolled back" and prepping incident blurb.
